title: Choose the visual world for Web Logo Studio
question: The roll assigned the Type Specimen direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Applies to the main site and /99.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.lineage: Foundry specimen sheets: one face shown at every size it must survive
options.thesis: The studio's work set like a foundry specimen: every logo and site proven at every size, billboard to favicon.
materials: bright specimen paper, rich black ink
one variable grotesk (Archivo) swinging condensed to expanded
size ladders, point-size captions, sheet numbers
options.viewport: Sheet header with sheet no. and live ET clock; the offer set as a size ladder on the left; a real portfolio logo shown at five sizes on the right; quote button under the ladder.
options.risk: Turns into a dry type poster if the real work does not carry the specimen.

raised.raise: A live ET studio clock is locked to one corner and says whether the 2-hour concept clock is running now.
One orange marking ink traces only the path the visitor commits to: the pay button, the active step, the chosen filter.
Home and away colorways: paper sections and inverse green sections swap ground while the logo stays untouched.
Tabular time stamps annotate the process: 0:00 pay, 0:05 send info, 2:00 first concept.

options.label: Printer's Proof
options.lineage: The approval proof a print or sign shop sends before anything is produced
options.thesis: Every project is a proof waiting for the client's sign-off: concept, approve, go live.
materials: job ticket and APPROVED stamp boxes
options.viewport: A proof sheet with crop marks framing the headline, a job ticket listing $99 / 2 hrs / 2 rounds, and the pay button set in the approval box.
options.risk: Crop marks and registration targets are a familiar design-studio motif; most runs in this category land near here.

options.label: Risograph Print
options.lineage: Riso-printed flyers and zines: spot inks misregistered on toothy paper
options.thesis: The studio as a print shop: two spot inks, slightly out of register, layered over warm paper.
materials: two spot inks that multiply where they overlap
options.viewport: Large cut-paper headline in green and orange ink layers, portfolio pieces printed as overlapping spot-ink cards.
options.case: Fuses well and feels made by hand; loses on clarity for growing companies who want precision.
options.risk: Reads indie-zine to a law firm or mortgage broker.

options.label: Sewing Pattern Envelope
options.lineage: Home sewing patterns: views A/B/C, yardage tables, dashed cutting lines
options.thesis: Packages as views on an envelope, the brief as a cutting layout.
options.viewport: Envelope front indexing website, logo and brand as views A, B and C.
options.case: Business owners don't identify with it, and it blurs what the studio sells.
options.kept: One marking ink traces only the committed path.

options.label: Emergency Broadcast
options.lineage: Colour bars, alert cards and a timecode in the corner
options.thesis: The studio as the only channel left on air.
options.viewport: Alert card headline with a crawl along the foot.
options.case: Alarming tone and noise hurt trust and LCP for paid traffic.
options.kept: A live clock locked to one corner.

options.label: Football Kit Wall
options.lineage: Crests, drop-shadow numbers, home and away colorways
options.thesis: Every client brand as a kit, crest over the heart.
options.viewport: A shirt back with the offer as the number.
options.case: Off-subject for most clients; clarity suffers.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.lineage: Architectural sections tracing a sunbeam through rooms
options.thesis: Time of day as the page's structure.
options.viewport: A building section with the 2-hour clock as the sunbeam.
options.case: Beautiful but abstract; the offer gets lost.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.viewport: A typed transcript ending in a pay prompt.
options.case: Tool costume; hostile to local-business owners.
options.kept: States print themselves as set text, not badges.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern agency site: big sans headline, portfolio grid, one accent CTA.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and two buttons left, featured project right, logo strip below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other studio by design.
